panels.description: Live player count from the A2S query port.
panels.title: Players online

panels.description: Average server tick rate. The server targets 60. Sustained drops below ~48 are what players feel as lag, and this moves before CPU or memory show anything.
panels.title: Tick rate

panels.description: Connected players whose Alderon ID appears in the server's admin list.
panels.title: Admins online

panels.description: Whether the server answers A2S queries. Independent of whether it is listed publicly.
panels.title: Server reachable

panels.description: The map the server is running and the weather it currently reports. ServerMap=Island is the Gondwa map.
panels.title: Map / weather

panels.description: The in-game clock. The server reports time of day as an HHMM integer (e.g. 1043 = 10:43); this converts it to seconds past midnight so it renders as a clock rather than a bare number.
panels.title: Game time of day

panels.description: Single series, so no legend is needed — the title names it. The dashed line is the configured slot cap.
panels.title: Players online

panels.description: Turnover rate. Joins persistently outrunning leaves with a flat player count means people are bouncing straight back out.
panels.title: Joins and leaves per hour

panels.description: The load signal that matters. Average pulling away from the 60 target is what players experience as degradation, and it moves before any resource metric does.
panels.title: Tick rate

panels.description: Both series are percentages of the container's CPU limit, so they share one axis. Throttling is the one that hurts: it stalls the game thread mid-tick and every player feels it at once.
panels.title: CPU

panels.description: Percentage of the container memory limit. An OOM kill disconnects every player at once, so headroom here matters more than the absolute number.
panels.title: Memory

panels.description: Which species are online right now. One hue rather than a colour per species — the bar length carries the count and the species name is read directly off each row.
panels.title: Species

panels.description: Players by growth stage, ordered hatchling → adult, so the ramp runs light to dark rather than using unrelated hues.
panels.title: Growth

panels.description: Distance from the group centre, in metres. Clustering is what drives replication cost up faster than player count alone — a tick rate dip with this falling means everyone piled into one place.
panels.title: How spread out players are

panels.description: How long people stay. A median collapsing toward a couple of minutes means players are joining and leaving again, which the player count alone will not show because the seat gets refilled.
panels.title: Session length

panels.description: Entries still in force in the game's own ban, mute and whitelist files. An enforced whitelist reading zero rejects every join while the server otherwise looks healthy.
panels.title: Moderation lists

panels.description: Most players within the configured cluster radius of any one player.
panels.title: Biggest group

panels.description: Successful pulses per minute to the Alderon server list. If this stops, the server vanishes from the public list and nobody new can find it — while it keeps running, holds tick rate and answers queries normally.
panels.title: Server-list heartbeat

panels.description: Failures reaching the BattlEye master. While these occur, bans are not being verified.
panels.title: BattlEye master

panels.description: The two exporters this dashboard depends on. If either drops, the panels above go stale rather than wrong — check here first when something looks frozen.
panels.title: Collectors up
